title: The Ofudesaki
altTitles: The Tip of the Writing Brush
author: nakayama-miki
attributionNote: Tenrikyo tradition attributes the verses to Nakayama Miki as revelations. The English translation is a separate published edition with its own rights.
description: The Ofudesaki is Tenrikyo’s central scriptural text, a collection of 1,711 verses in seventeen parts. It addresses the founding of the teaching and the path to a joyous life.
historicalContext: Composed in nineteenth-century Japan during the movement’s formative period. Tenrikyo official publications provide translations and doctrinal exposition; these are not the same as the scripture.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Official English translations are copyrighted and no open licence was found. No text is imported.
